description: TableLink is a reservation platform used by independent restaurants. The connector finds a TableLink restaurant, checks live availability, and books or cancels a reservation on the diner's behalf — all from your chat. Diners need a TableLink account (free) to book; the connector handles the OAuth sign-in. Cancellations are one-click via the link the connector returns.
